name: competicao-pipa-live
description: Jogo interativo de disputa de relinho de pipa para TikTok Live

scripts.kill: powershell -Command "Get-NetTCPConnection -LocalPort 3000,5173 -ErrorAction SilentlyContinue | ForEach-Object { Stop-Process -Id $_.OwningProcess -Force -ErrorAction SilentlyContinue }; Write-Host 'Portas 3000 e 5173 liberadas!'"
scripts.restart: npm run kill && npm run dev
